description: A dataset of global tropical cyclone wind and surface wave measurements from buoy and satellite platforms is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Ali Tamizi et al. There are now a range of potential data sources for wind and surface wave conditions within tropical cyclones. These sources include: in situ buoy data and remote sensing data from satellite altimeters, scatterometers, and radiometers. In addition, data providing estimates of tropical cyclone tracks and wind field parameters are available from best track archives. Coverage: global; published in 2024. Formats: NetCDF, MATLAB. The data are held in Australian research data and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 814185977 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
